cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Everything Is a Contest
cards.instruction: Turn every difference or disagreement into a competition you intend to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You pulled out a row so neatly that I've pulled out three. Let's see who finishes with fewer mistakes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was fixing one wrong stitch. You've undone correct rows.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three fewer rows that could be wrong, then. Count yours and we'll compare.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Longest stretch of yarn, then. Mine's coming out in one piece. Let's measure before you cut yours off the ball.

reason: Make the borrowed misunderstanding concrete while preserving the Drive-specific response to each actual partner contribution. D18 retains useful original beats rather than replacing effective material unnecessarily.
